about.desc: Redbrick Robotics empowers students, engineers, and developers to master real-world robotics from first principles. We bridge the gap between theoretical software and physical autonomous machines through hands-on, interactive education.
about.pillar1Desc: Robotics runs on Linux. We teach Ubuntu 24.04 command-line, hardware permissions, udev rules, and system configuration directly inside the browser.
about.pillar2Desc: Focused strictly on ROS 2 Jazzy Jalisco. No legacy ROS 1 confusion. Learn DDS peer-to-peer discovery, Python rclpy, TF2, and Nav2 navigation.
about.pillar3Desc: Every example ties directly to real physical hardware: Raspberry Pi 5, ESP32 micro-ROS agents, 2D LiDARs, depth cameras, and motor drivers.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to start your robotics journey?
about.ctaDesc: Start with Linux command-line basics and work your way to autonomous robots.
